notes: Event ID: EVT-002 | Shipment: SHP-1003 | SKU: BRG-310 | Disruption: Quality hold on 5,000 units from Chennai Bearing Works (SUP-IN06), delayed from 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-25 (17 days).
Impact: CHI-DC stockout on 2026-10-13; three at-risk orders totaling 1,800 units with $7,600 penalty exposure. Two Tier A orders (SO-9012, SO-9014) from Heartland Ag Equipment must be protected.

Inventory Position: CHI-DC has 900 units on hand (safety stock 300); DAL-DC has 1,500 units (safety stock 400, committed 300, transferable 800); ATL-DC has 600 units (safety stock 200, committed 0, transferable 400). Total transferable: 1,200 units.
Alternate Supplier: Cuyahoga Bearing Co (SUP-US07) is approved, can supply 1,300 units by 2026-10-06 at $9.20/unit (vs. $6.50 original cost, $3.70 premium per unit = $3,510 total premium).

Expedite Options: Air express freight ($5,232.50, arriving 2026-10-04) and air standard freight ($3,094, arriving 2026-10-07) are available but only justified if protecting Tier A orders or if penalty avoidance exceeds cost.

Recommended Path: OPT-2 (DC transfers + 100-unit alternate supplier purchase) or OPT-3 (full alternate supplier) offer lowest-cost compliance with all business rules. OPT-4 and OPT-5 (supplier rework acceleration) are zero-cost if achievable but carry medium-to-high execution risk given quality hold complexity.
Approval Requirements: OPT-2 ($1,670), OPT-3 ($3,510), and OPT-6 ($1,638) all fall below $10,000 threshold and require only sourcing manager approval. No VP-level approval needed.

Customer Communication: If OPT-1 is selected, Heartland Ag Equipment (Tier A) must receive personalized notice that SO-9014 will ship 3 days late (2026-10-23 vs. due date 2026-10-17). All other options protect both Tier A orders and require only standard order confirmation updates.

Quality Hold Risk: Medium confidence in 2026-10-25 ETA due to rework complexity. If supplier cannot meet accelerated dates (OPT-4, OPT-5), fallback to OPT-2 or OPT-3 must be executed immediately. Recommend securing alternate supplier commitment in parallel as insurance.
